as_told.title: Foratu's second hypothesis: infection from a scratch by the being

plain: A pathologist, a doctor who studies causes of illness and death, known as Dr. Armando, speaks about a case in Varginha, Brazil, in 1996. Looking at the autopsy report of a man named Marco Chereze, he says there was a very distinct and deliberate scratch on his skin, and he links the infection that followed to the claw of a strange being. If true, it would mean contact with a non-human creature could injure and infect a person.
